description: This file defines the SecurityPolicyInterface for Twig's sandbox security system. It declares methods for checking security constraints on tags, filters, functions, methods, and properties.

classes.name: SecurityPolicyInterface
classes.description: Interface that all security policy classes must implement, defining methods for security checks related to Twig's sandbox feature.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks security permissions for tags, filters, and functions. Throws SecurityError if security constraints are violated.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific method on an object is allowed. Throws SecurityNotAllowedMethodError if not allowed.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific property on an object is allowed. Throws SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError if not allowed.
